question: Where can I get a list of thermal and nuclear power plants in Spain, with location, fuel or technology, capacity (MW), operator, status and annual generation?

answer.summary: No single open Spanish dataset lists all thermal and nuclear power plants with electrical capacity (MW), operator, status, coordinates, and annual generation. MITECO's statutory registry (RAIPEE: REPROv2 and PRETOR) is gated by CAPTCHA/login, while REE's e-sios unit list requires an API token and hits WAF blocks. Best open options: combine EEA Industrial Reporting v16 (thermal >=50 MWth through 2024, coords, thermal MWth and fuel TJ, not GWh), MITECO/IAEA PRIS plus Foro Nuclear 2025 PDF (nuclear MW, operator, status, 2025 GWh), and ENTSO-E (>=100 MW, free registration) for thermal MWe and annual MWh, or GEM GIPT (request form, Sept 2026) for current >=20-30 MW plant lists.
main_caveats: MITECO RAIPEE (REPROv2/PRETOR) is CAPTCHA/login-gated, REE e-sios requires a token and hits Incapsula WAF, and Electra CSV drops technical fields.
EEA Industrial Reporting v16 (F5_2) and MITECO WFS report rated thermal input (MWth) and fuel input (TJ), NOT electrical MW or GWh, and mix industrial boilers with power plants.
Official MITECO/EEA reporting completeness gaps for Spain are explicitly flagged in EEA v16 metadata; MITECO WFS ei_gp_combustion is frozen at 2018-2019 (still marks closed coal plants functional).
ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (14.1.b, 16.1.a) covers electrical MW and actual generation per unit, but requires registration and excludes units below 100 MW.
Non-official WRI GPPD (2021, 2 coord errors in Spain, 0 reported ES generation) and JRC-PPDB-OPEN (2019, coords on 119/648 thermal/nuclear rows) are outdated.
answer.confidence_reason: Verified directly across MITECO (REPROv2, PRETOR, Electra, WFS, stats), REE/e-sios, CNMC, CSN, BOE, EEA v16, ENTSO-E, IAEA PRIS, Foro Nuclear, GEM, WRI, JRC, and OSM.

attributes.note: Coords: EEA (1), WFS (8), GEM (9), WRI (10, 2 errors), JRC (11, 119/648), OSM (12, 182 sites). Site/municipality only: ENTSO-E (2), IAEA (5), MITECO/CSN (6), ForoNuc (7).
attributes.gap_note: REE e-sios (4) omits location; MITECO/IAEA/ENTSO-E lack coords; JRC lacks coords on 529/648 ES thermal/nuclear rows; thermal units <50 MWth lack open official coordinates.

attributes.note: EEA (1) & WFS (8) give fuel TJ/burner (>=50MWth); ENTSO-E (2) & e-sios (4) give production type (reg/WAF); nuclear (5-7); GEM (9), WRI (10), JRC (11), OSM (12) classify fuel.
attributes.gap_note: No open official bulk table classifies fuel/technology for Spanish thermal plants <50 MWth (RAIPEE 3 is CAPTCHA/login-gated, REE e-sios 4 is token/WAF-blocked, Electra omits technology).

attributes.note: MWe open for nuclear (5-7) & stale WRI/JRC/OSM (10-12); ENTSO-E >=100MW reg (2); RAIPEE/e-sios blocked (3,4); GEM form (9). EEA (1) & WFS (8) give thermal MWth, not MWe.
attributes.gap_note: Open official bulk downloads do not publish current electrical capacity (MWe) for Spanish thermal plants <100 MW (RAIPEE 3 is CAPTCHA-gated, REE e-sios 4 is token/WAF-blocked).

attributes.note: Nuclear operator/owners: IAEA (5), MITECO/CSN (6), ForoNuc (7). Thermal: RAIPEE holder CAPTCHA (3), e-sios SM/BRP WAF (4), GEM form (9), WRI 2021 owner (10), OSM 69/182 (12).
attributes.gap_note: Open official thermal bulk downloads (EEA F5_2/F1_4/F6_1, MITECO WFS, JRC) and ENTSO-E 14.1.b omit operator; Electra CSV lists installation names without fuel or MW.

attributes.note: Nuclear: IAEA/CSN/ForoNuc (5-7). Thermal: EEA F6_1 (1), RAIPEE previa/def CAPTCHA (3), WFS 2018-19 (8), GEM form (9), JRC 117/648 (11). REE e-sios (4) & WRI (10) omit status.
attributes.gap_note: Unified current administrative status for all thermal plants is gated inside MITECO REPROv2/PRETOR (3) and BOE closure resolutions; JRC is blank on 531/648 ES thermal/nuclear rows.

attributes.note: ENTSO-E 16.1.a >=100MW reg (2); Foro Nuclear 2025 GWh for 7 nuclear units (7); WRI modeled 2017 est. only, 0 reported (10); JRC 2015-2018 MWh (11). OSM (12) has none.
attributes.gap_note: No open bulk dataset publishes current plant-level annual electricity generation (MWh/GWh) for Spanish thermal plants; EEA (1) gives fuel TJ and IAEA API (5) gives lifetime TWh only.

key_fields.meaning: INSPIRE ID of the Large Combustion Plant unit/part (F5_2_LCP_Energy_Emissions.csv)
Name of the combustion plant/unit
Metric type: LCPCharacteristics (MWth, hours), NaturalGas, Coal, LiquidFuels, Biomass, OtherGases, NOX, SO2, DUST
Numeric value corresponding to featureType and unit (MW, hours, TJ, tonnes)
WGS84 point coordinates
Activity code in F1_4_Air_Releases_Facilities.csv ('1(c)' = Thermal power stations and other combustion installations)

steps: Download User friendly .csv files.zip (147.6 MB) from https://sdi.eea.europa.eu/data/657ac3cb-affa-4295-a4a9-27b4f539adab (share token AnfiqFkZYBSq36B, supports HTTP Range) or use SiteMap.gdb.zip (90.7 MB) from token WQpi7BEjScefLYL.

Extract F5_2_LCP_Energy_Emissions.csv (LCP thermal capacity, operating hours, fuel TJ by year), F1_4_Air_Releases_Facilities.csv (E-PRTR facilities), and F6_1_IED_Installations.csv (IED installationStatus and permitURL).

Filter F5_2 by countryName == 'Spain' (31,356 rows, 356 unique LCPInspireId across 2016-2024, 264 in 2024) and F1_4 by countryName == 'Spain' and EPRTRAnnexIMainActivity == '1(c)' (159 unique facilities).
Pivot F5_2 by (LCPInspireId, reportingYear) and (featureType, unit) to separate rated thermal input (unit == 'MW'), operating hours (unit == 'hours'), and fuel inputs (unit == 'TJ').
reading_traps: unit == 'MW' in F5_2 is rated thermal input (MWth), NOT electrical output capacity (MWe).

Includes industrial boilers, refineries, and chemical heaters alongside power stations (e.g., CALDERA F-5103); cross-filter with F1_4 activity '1(c)' or plant names/CNAE to isolate electricity generators.
Contains fuel energy input in TJ, NOT electricity generated in MWh/GWh, and omits operator in F5_2, F1_4, and F6_1.
Official metadata explicitly notes Spain's EU Registry / LCP reporting has completeness gaps.

problems: Full CSV ZIP exceeds 100 MB (147.6 MB); F5_2_LCP_Energy_Emissions.csv (31,356 ES rows, 356 unique LCPs, 0/356 outside Spain), F1_4_Air_Releases_Facilities.csv (159 ES 1(c) facilities, 0/159 outside Spain), and F6_1_IED_Installations.csv header/schema were verified via HTTP Range slices.

coverage.geographic: Pan-European bidding zones / control areas, including Spain (10YES-REE------0)

unit.quote: Actual net generation output (MW) per market time unit and per generation unit of 100 MW or more installed generation capacity.

key_fields.meaning: Production/generation unit name and 16-character EIC code (e.g., 18W...)
Net installed electrical generation capacity in MW (Art. 14.1.b, documentType=A71)
ENTSO-E fuel/technology classification (Nuclear, Fossil Gas, Fossil Hard coal, Biomass, etc.)
Net electrical output per MTU (Art. 16.1.a, documentType=A73, processType=A16); integrate over year for MWh
Administrative location/substation reference and kV connection level

steps: Create a free account on https://transparency.entsoe.eu/ and email transparency@entsoe.eu to activate your RESTful API securityToken (or access the File Library FMS).
Query Installed Capacity per Production Unit (documentType=A71, processType=A33, in_Domain=10YES-REE------0) on https://web-api.tp.entsoe.eu/api to retrieve Spain thermal and nuclear units >=100 MW.
Query Actual Generation Output per Generation Unit (documentType=A73, processType=A16, in_Domain=10YES-REE------0) across a full calendar year and aggregate MTU MW outputs to annual MWh per unit.
reading_traps: Units < 100 MW (most cogeneration, biomass, waste, and smaller island thermal units) are excluded by regulation.
Help center articles on transparencyplatform.zendesk.com return HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) to automated HTTP clients; technical specs are openly downloadable in MoP_Ref2_DDD_v3r4.pdf on entsoe.eu.

problems: Web export, File Library (FMS), and REST API require free user registration and token; Zendesk Help Center pages returned 403 to curl.

evidence.claim: 14.1.b mandates publishing unit name, MW capacity, location, voltage, bidding zone, and production type for units >= 100 MW
evidence.quote: Information about production units (existing and planned) with an installed generation capacity equalling to or exceeding 100 MW. The information shall contain: – the unit name; – the installed generation capacity (MW); – the location; – the voltage connection level; – the bidding zone; – the production type.

evidence.claim: 16.1.a mandates actual net generation output per unit >= 100 MW published D+5
evidence.quote: Actual net generation output (MW) per market time unit and per generation unit of 100 MW or more installed generation capacity. The information shall be published five days after the end of the operational period.

recipe: 1. Start from the combined baseline list of EEA v16 (F5_2 & F1_4 for >=50 MWth thermal) + IAEA PRIS + Foro Nuclear 2025 PDF (nuclear) + MITECO WFS ei_instalaciones (for permiturl/PRTR IDs).

2. For any missing or uncertain status/closure/license renewal, search BOE advanced search (https://www.boe.es/buscar/boe.php) by exact plant name under Sección III to confirm closure resolutions (e.g., BOE-A-2020-17142) or nuclear extensions (BOE-A-2021-5109).

3. Open each thermal plant's PRTR-España ficha (fichacomplejo.aspx?Id_Complejo=...) or the permiturl from MITECO WFS ei_instalaciones to verify exact operator/parent company, operational status, and regional AAI permit technical annex (which states electrical MW when not shown in EEA).

4. For nuclear annual generation (GWh), extract printed page 28 of Foro Nuclear's annual PDF (render via pdftoppm -png because pdftotext fails on outlined glyphs). Note: annual plant-level generation for thermal plants <100 MW is not available in unstructured public documents and requires ENTSO-E (>=100 MW, registered) or e-sios/TSO access.

related_not_answering.name: CNMC Data - Evolución anual de producción (renovables, cogeneración y residuos)
related_not_answering.why: Publishes aggregate regional/technology totals only and excludes conventional non-cogeneration thermal and nuclear power plants.

related_not_answering.name: PRTR-España XML Complejos y Emisiones
related_not_answering.why: PRTR_Espana_MITECO_Complejos.xml (9,430 complexes; 188 in 1.c/IPPC 1.1) omits coordinates, MW capacity, status, and electricity generation (covered with coordinates in EEA v16 and MITECO WFS).

related_not_answering.name: MITECO WFS Instalaciones Comercio de Derechos de Emisión (CDE)
related_not_answering.why: Lists 1,438 EU ETS industrial sites with CO2 emissions only through 2017/2020 (2021-2025 fields empty); lacks activity/technology classification, MW capacity, and electricity generation.

related_not_answering.name: Govern de les Illes Balears - Grups centrals convencionals de producció energètica
related_not_answering.why: Balearic Islands GeoJSON (45 points) contains only a CATEGORIA code ('T10'-'T60') and coordinates—no plant name, fuel, MW capacity, operator, status, or annual generation.

open_questions: Does REE's token-authenticated api.esios.ree.es/archives/81 (Unidades Físicas) export unit-level fuel/technology and installed capacity without WAF blocking once a personal x-api-key header is supplied?
Do MITECO's CAPTCHA-gated REPROv2/PRETOR applications expose coordinates or municipal location only, and do their internal records distinguish active vs hibernated/mothballed units?

history.note: Initial research pass mapping RAIPEE (REPROv2/PRETOR CAPTCHA-gated), REE e-sios (WAF/token-blocked), MITECO WFS/nuclear, EEA IED/LCP v16, ENTSO-E, IAEA PRIS, Foro Nuclear, GEM, WRI, JRC, and OSM.
